original_sentence: The technology exists, it just needs knitting together cost-effectively and in a way diners buy into.
translation: 技术已经存在，只是还需要以有成本效益、且能被食客接受的方式整合起来。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: buy into 在本句中对应"接受；认同"。
knit together 在本句中对应"整合起来"。
cost-effectively 在本句中对应"以低成本高效方式"。

sentence_structure.main_structure: The technology exists, it just needs knitting together cost-effectively and in a way diners buy into.

analysis_points.part: The technology exists, it just needs knitting together cost-effectively and in a way diners buy into.
analysis_points.explanation_cn: 两个分句并列；needs knitting together 是 need doing 结构；diners buy into 修饰 way。
